summary: Galaga entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Galaga

emulation.emulator: MAME for original arcade comparison only
emulation.notes: Prefer official Arcade Archives for main play; use MAME/original hardware for timing comparison.

primary.why: The official Arcade Archives release centers the 1981 Namco arcade game with modern access and capture, while original arcade hardware/MAME remains useful for input/timing comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official Arcade Archives release. Record platform, display settings, difficulty/dip-switch equivalents, input latency, and whether a MAME/original cabinet comparison was made.

secondary.what_to_play: Run a short comparison only if original arcade behavior is being documented.
secondary.why: The official rerelease is the practical route, but original hardware remains the benchmark.

all_releases.reason: skip: useful for port history only.
primary: best legal modern route for the arcade original.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Official rerelease is the main route; original arcade hardware is the comparison ceiling.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record display/filter/assist settings and control method.
